name: A. Troy Hunter
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Issaquah, Washington
education: University of Washington School of Law
about: A. Troy Hunter is an attorney with Injury Law Group NW in Issaquah, Washington, where he represents individuals and families in a wide range of personal injury and civil litigation matters. His practice focuses on motor vehicle accidents, wrongful death claims, construction accidents, traumatic brain injuries, trucking accidents, premises liability and other personal injury cases on behalf of plaintiffs. With extensive experience advocating for injured clients, he is committed to guiding individuals through every stage of the legal process while pursuing fair and favorable outcomes.

Mr. Hunter approaches each case with careful preparation and a client-focused perspective, developing legal strategies tailored to the unique circumstances of every matter. He works closely with clients to face complex litigation, helping them address the legal and financial challenges that often follow serious injuries. Whether negotiating settlements or representing clients in court, he strives to protect their rights and interests throughout the process.

Mr. Hunter completed his undergraduate studies from the University of Washington before obtaining his Juris Doctor from the University of Washington School of Law. His educational background provides a strong foundation for handling complex civil litigation and personal injury claims.

Admitted to practice in Washington since 1999, Mr. Hunter was also admitted to practice in Alaska in 2016. Over the course of his career, he has built a reputation for professionalism and dedication to client advocacy. In recognition of his legal abilities and ethical standards, he has earned an AV Preeminent* peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell.

An active participant in the legal community, Mr. Hunter maintains memberships in several professional organizations, including the American Bar Association, the Washington State Bar Association and the King County Bar Association. Through his practice, he remains dedicated to providing knowledgeable legal counsel and strong representation for clients facing the challenges of serious personal injury and civil litigation.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
